items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 19 September 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Complex area of low pressure near Iceland as a waving frontal zone affects the British Isles.


##Wind##

West or southwest, veering west overnight into Sunday, 5 or 6.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 5 or 6, soon decreasing 4 or 5, backing southwest 3 or 4 in the evening, increasing 4 or 5 overnight into Monday and occasionally 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, soon becoming slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair, then a risk of a few outbreaks of rain or drizzle overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, perhaps moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.
